As audiences increasingly consume information visually and through mobile devices, video has become the primary format through which InfoSheba explains services, entitlements and protection risks. The role is based in the Ukhiya Office under the direct supervision of the Editorial Manager, and works closely with the wider editorial team, Information Corner facilitators, consortium partners and IRC programme sectors.
